_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 30d momentum flat near 50 and score coil make HOLD the honest base rate; intake/skew are a downside cluster but have not broken the range.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative implies distribution pressure without a phase call; consensus stays HOLD at current rung
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, 30d momentum near 50, fear/greed holds 60s, no sustained CVD breakdown
next_move.invalidated_if: Range breaks with CVD suppressed and fear/greed through mid-50s (down to Disbelief) or ETF flows/CVD thrust higher (up to Optimism)
